name: vote of the nearest stored examples
mechanism: store all training examples; to predict, find the k stored examples closest to the query under a distance and return their majority label or average value

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'k-nearest neighbors (k-NN)' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification: a non-parametric method for classifying objects based on closest training examples in the feature space

fails_when: distance meaningless in high dimension; cost per query linear without an index
